status_labels.analogue: E19 HISTORICAL ANALOGUE; NOT THE PROPOSED LM/SEAL

G_inputs.rule: Pinned/licensed/group-disjoint allowed data only; no task/source IDs or future outcomes in routing; E20 suffix revealed only after saved prefix decisions.

G_core.rule: Hash/freeze base tensors; preserve common-start outputs; no model code, tokenizer, evaluator or safety-gate edits. E19 freezing starts after A training, not pretrained initialization.

G_energy.rule: E21 protocol/compute/data lock first; scalar E and real grad_z update; CE must train the energy through the update; finite-difference/nonzero-gradient/bypass tests; independent quality and equal measured-compute controls. Energy decrease alone fails the capability claim.

G_control.rule: Same functional head capacity, initial conditions, restoring drift, decoder and permitted data; independently verify real tensor counts; report equal-data and equal-compute views without conflating them.

G_detector.rule: Causal observed feedback and development-only thresholds; no oracle onset or final-score calibration; E19 strict timing gate stays failed. E20 B3/D3 candidate rules are not approval or a universal false-alarm guarantee.

G_router.rule: Prefix/input-only routing, no true task/answer/test identity; log selections and independent oracle gap only as a diagnostic. If learned capability is accessible only with oracle routing, the autonomous system fails.

G_adapt.rule: Approved allocation cap and method-specific identity test; train only allowed new weights with logged causal exposure. E19 zero-init residual differs from E20 cloning; no claim that core freezing proves retention.

G_replay.rule: Training-only bounded reservoir; log repeats, bytes and fresh-data tradeoff; charge replay work. Never replay development/final examples or silently add extra updates.

G_promotion.rule: Human review of a precommitted candidate and independent validity/quality/retention/cost verdict; PASS licenses the stated next test, not automatic deployment. Reject/incomplete/invalid retains the accepted baseline; Majied approves budget or project-gate changes.

G_swap.rule: Long-term prerequisite: immutable A/B manifests, atomic whole-state pointer change, only the authorized candidate editable, frozen side hashes unchanged, interruption/failure restore drills. This new engineering gate is proposed, not measured or already preregistered.

G_eval.rule: Separate custodian, real access isolation, immutable all-arm artifacts, one locked final transaction, no adaptive final queries, no post-hoc checkpoint/threshold choice. E19 official-test scoring was not a demonstrated ACL-enforced custodian seal.

G_cost.rule: Cost collector outside candidate write authority; count data, detector, routing, training and generation; reject NaN/missing/zero counts; equal steps do not prove equal compute. E19 records limited adaptation wall time, not full LLM/GPU cost.

G_publish.rule: Per-EXX raw/protocol/source/verdict; preserve failures; separate task/model classes; sanitize licensed corpus/test content; human website PR and desktop/mobile/live-byte verification. A proposed graph is not a measured EXX result.

G_tiers.rule: Long-term development tests: accurate cold/resident expert identity, bounded p95 paging latency, state/optimizer integrity and full resident comparison; no unbounded-growth or ternary-speed claim without its own tests. Budget enlargement needs owner approval.

boundaries.B_ingress: Untrusted corpus/user text -> approved, provenance-checked input; source metadata kept out of model decisions.
boundaries.B_runtime: Sandbox model/latent computations; read-only frozen base, no network or code/safety/evaluator mutation authority.
boundaries.B_training: Trainable candidate, bounded replay and causal keys only; no development/final data access.
boundaries.B_feedback: Observed outcomes from the allowed stream only -> detector; no final-test or oracle phase feedback.
boundaries.B_eval: Independent custodian owns final data/evaluator; model artifacts cross read-only, never trainer-accessible final text or adaptive score queries.
boundaries.B_governance: Human protocol/release authorization separated from learned detector/model output; no autonomous acceptance-gate rewriting.
boundaries.B_metrics: Protected measurement/record collector can observe candidates but candidates cannot rewrite measurement or outcome records.
boundaries.B_public: Reviewed export -> public log; no raw sealed/licensed text, credentials or model-control channel.
boundaries.B_tiers: Content-addressed resident/cold expert artifacts; checked identity and approved storage/I/O budget; not a memory tier deployed by this draft.

failures.R_quarantine: Deny suspect input/metadata, quarantine offending record and stop the relevant arm; preserve evidence. Exposed-final integrity correction requires a fresh experiment/test, not test repair.
failures.R_baseline: Retain the immutable reference/core state; mark the candidate or router failure. In a preregistered run, do not silently replace a failing arm with baseline output and call it success.
failures.R_abort_arm: Stop unsafe/nonfinite/over-budget candidate work, preserve partial logs and report failed/incomplete seed. No replacement seed or score-driven tuning.
failures.R_no_growth: No allowed causal trigger -> no allocation; score the unchanged system. False alarms, wrong routes and cap saturation remain recorded failures/diagnostics.
failures.R_no_promotion: Reject promotion on failed/incomplete/invalid evidence; keep last accepted version and publish the narrow verdict, including negatives.
failures.R_restore_state: Proposed whole-state rollback: restore base/hash, adapter/expert weights, router keys, active-slot pointer, replay/optimizer lineage and compatible version manifest. Do not restore weights while retaining incompatible routing state.
failures.R_restore_pair: Proposed A/B rollback: atomically restore both manifests and active/frozen roles; quarantine interrupted candidate; neither side may edit evaluator/code/safety controls.
failures.R_incomplete: Mark missing/malformed cost or scoring evidence INCOMPLETE; do not invent estimates or publish a pass.
failures.R_keep_public: Keep prior verified result release; correct/version the new export through review. A deployment failure means not live; old negative records remain visible.
failures.R_resident: Stop paging/grafting test; use the predeclared all-resident or no-graft comparator for diagnosis, not as a relabeled success; owner decides any enlarged budget.

nodes.label: Allowed stream / delayed outcomes
nodes.note: Curator labels assemble cohorts; they are never model routing inputs. Sealed final remains with evaluator.

nodes.label: Frozen pretrained LM
nodes.note: Original weights stay unchanged after designated warm-up/freeze; changed routing/residuals can still change competence.

nodes.label: Trained scalar-energy latent refiner
nodes.note: Continuous latent only; CE through updates trains E. Lower E is diagnostic, not task-quality evidence or a calibrated detector.

nodes.label: Matched direct-update control
nodes.note: Separate experimental arm, not an online fallback relabeled as energy; one-step and K=0 controls also required.

nodes.label: Novelty / observed-feedback detector
nodes.note: Input-only novelty cannot resolve identical-input label-only shifts. No E21 absolute-energy-to-growth connection is authorized.

nodes.label: Router / expert-key store
nodes.note: E19 has two centroids and a linear residual, not a tiered expert library. E20 keys use frozen unadapted-prefix features, not task IDs.

nodes.label: Adapter / bounded growth
nodes.note: Clone != zero-init sprout. Training uses active chronological slot; proposed E20 inference uses router-selected slot.

nodes.label: Rehearsal / bounded replay
nodes.note: A separate R24 arm, not free replay added to B3; no E19 replay was implemented in its primary adaptation.

nodes.label: Human promotion / rollback gate
nodes.note: Human authorization, not a model-run service. Whole-state rollback is a proposed safeguard; E21 PASS does not auto-promote a generator.

nodes.label: A/B freeze-swap coordinator
nodes.note: Design intent only. No coding the other model's code, evaluator, metrics or safety gate; edits restricted to approved parameter sandbox.

nodes.label: Independent sealed evaluator
nodes.note: E19 test now inspected and cannot become E20/E21's fresh final. Evaluation artifacts return to human/publication, not the learning loop.

nodes.label: Telemetry / measured costs / raw ledger
nodes.note: Read-only observation authority; candidate cannot change collector. CUDA-event elapsed is not exact busy-SM time/FLOPs.

nodes.label: Public per-EXX result publishing
